{{Otheruses|Omega}}
'''Omega group''' was a group of three [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|''Gamma''-class ATR-6 assault transports]] that served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was present at the [[Battle of Pondut]].
